title: Microsoft Copilot: comment on a Page to ask Copilot questions or request edits
summary: Hold: the Graph automation omits a restriction that makes it fail when the setting is configured in a group-level policy. The roadmap details and the existing Pages licensing and controls are otherwise supported, but the description of a move from private chat is not established by the sources.

claims.fix: Keep the call. Add to controls[0].note and the Graph paragraph: 'TCM supports this setting only in tenant-level policies.
